name: comp-310

frames.best_why: Frame 1 shows the full strip with the countdown at 22s and the cursor below it.
frames.render_note: The left edge is cropped, so the circular ticket badge is cut off.

tagline: Sale strip counts down hours, minutes and seconds beside a Buy now button.
summary: A full-width dark promo bar with a Black Friday headline, a live countdown in divided cells, a white Buy now button and a close X. It removes itself when the timer runs out.
appearance: A full-width dark strip: a bold sale headline over one muted line on the left, then a tinted rounded box split into hour, minute and second cells, a white Buy now pill and a faint X. A ticket badge is cut off at the left edge.
behaviour: The countdown drops by one second on each tick; when it reaches zero the whole bar removes itself. The X hides it early, and the X brightens on hover.
demo_content: Black Friday Sale! It kicks off today and is available for just 24 hours—don't miss out!
search_phrases: sale ends in hours minutes seconds
promo bar with countdown and close
urgency timer at top of page
use_when: A time-limited sale needs a visible countdown next to a buy action.
avoid_when: It hides itself when the timer ends and the end date lives in code, so a new sale needs a rebuild.
customise: Headline, description and button label are hardcoded, and the sale end date is a module-level constant.
weight_why: One strip and a once-per-second state update that stops when it is dismissed.

a11y.note: Close is labelled and the ticket badge hidden, but the changing seconds are not announced to screen readers.

issues: The crop hides the ticket badge at the left edge.
Buy now has no handler, so it leads nowhere.
polish_why: Organised promo strip with a clear countdown; stock styling and a cropped badge.
title: Sale Countdown Banner
